events.text: The pilgrim granaries of Dasetodu stand empty while the lords of Timviq feast; the hungry batter at the chapter-house doors.
A bone-masked seer, Saqapinga, descends into Puluviqa and speaks the names of those who will die before spring.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Ruti (Qukigu); tax riots in Kuojing; bread riots in Likitleho; tax riots in Amumimar (Imajalmiut).
Galjuaq Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Galjuaq, siphoning 238 gold into their hoard.
Donzon Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Donzon, siphoning 9 gold into their hoard.
Fozhabad Outlaw Lair raided trade routes near Fozhabad, siphoning 104 gold into their hoard.
Vikfish Outlaw Lair raided trade routes near Vikfish, siphoning 54 gold into their hoard.
Refabad Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Refabad, siphoning 48 gold into their hoard.

Zebole Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Zebole, siphoning 6 gold into their hoard.
Chukewgondar Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Chukewgondar, siphoning 126 gold into their hoard.

Sava of Munsankoku comes to the throne bent on a lasting legacy.
Maka of Ngaviq comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
Busari of Daseruku comes to the throne bent on the safety of the lordship.
Halo of Likitleho comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
House Ivisang of Imajalmiut and House Inuqas of Ivitigal were joined in royal marriage.
Leu of Fuodu comes to the throne bent on the safety of the lordship.
Naqsup conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Frozen Ridge) using assault (score 21 vs DC 8). Defeated Astra. Promoted to F-Rank!
Ulutupuga survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 8 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Under 'Pan-Continental Coalition Against Ancient Titans', combined sovereign vanguards mobilized across frontiers, defeating rampaging beasts.
Pan-continental sanctions fell upon Ivituqun, cutting commercial maritime trade and isolating their regency.
The World Congress ratified 'Edict on the Prohibition of Dread Sorcery', outlawing catastrophic dark sorcery across all civilized borders.
Lufobe stands condemned as a rogue state in defiance of World Congress law, suffering trade embargoes.
Hashezegondar stands condemned as a rogue state in defiance of World Congress law, suffering trade embargoes.
Ivituqun stands condemned as a rogue state in defiance of World Congress law, suffering trade embargoes.
Stone markers are raised on the tundra beyond Jaklanqam to guide travellers home.
Beta Qigo completes a church hewn from living rock at Qusiku, a marvel of the Dosehelakewu people.
The court of Ijiguptuq bans the Silent Circle of Mehnihseneh; its masters flee across the border.
The court of Munsankoku bans the Crimson Guild of Silanguniq; its masters flee across the border.
Timviq imposes communes upon its vassal Dasetodu.
A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of Ivitigal around Ukatigal; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
Delvers of Chihiptlan break into a forgotten dwarven gallery beyond Hipi; the deep realm grows.
Borne on the winds, Kiljuljakpak now drifts above the lands of Nantun.
A cold upwelling chills the domes of Jap'op; kelp farms wither and the reefs bleach.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Pisalicho bars the shaft to Angisiniq, and the tithe-collectors of Beta Qigo are turned back at the lamps of Pisalicho.
Puluviqa squeezes the shaft-tolls of Ruti; the miners of Qukigu mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Lujakigu bars the shaft to Puluviqa, and the tithe-collectors of Puluviqa are turned back at the lamps of Qukigu.
The Border War of Chihiptlan is known as the Holy Defence among the Tensinkun, and as the Heretics' War among the Tlamo.
A catastrophic blow to Woe: legions of Fuodu overrun the citadel of Suakhuoloo, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: Shattered Lordship of Ivituqun is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Ijingaq Aturang flees into obscurity.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Empire of Woe ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Lea Khealaunao flees the ashes of their former dominion.
The War of the Ivituqun Crown reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Pukkivshahr triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Border War of Woe after 1 year. With frontiers redrawn, Fuodu dictate terms to the vanquished.
Flames engulf the towers of Yonsin! Soldiers of Luu force the inner courtyards of Yonsin's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.

The Invasion of Yuti is known as the Holy Defence among the Qilqas, and as the Heretics' War among the Dosehelakewu.
TITAN REAWAKENING: After centuries of primordial slumber, the immortal The Thousand-Tentacled Horror (Abyssal Kraken) awakens in Wilds beyond Loteshesha! Its primeval fury shakes the continent.
Nantun marches an army across the Starlit Gate into Tlotri, storming Te Voriwe!
Flames engulf the towers of Zhitzes! Soldiers of Zhodhin force the inner courtyards of Gulstan's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Free Union of Gulstan ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Nonreda Metpid flees the ashes of their former dominion.
A victor's peace is forged: after 2 years of campaign in the War of the Gulstan Crown, Zhodhin prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Madqilia overruns the defensive holdfasts of Ladbulsel, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Shochia.
Whale Thanks: Boats of Ijiguptuq are blessed and raced off Ijiguptuq; sailors are toasted ashore.

Feast of the Harvest Drums: Granaries of Daseruku are opened at Daseruku; the whole town eats until dusk.
The long quarrel known as the Zizzutbos-Safotozo feud cools at last.
Envoys from Vaqjuq and Bufumbe exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.

Ambition stirs in the courts of Grand Duchy of Fimpe, which openly claims dominion over Polytechnic League of Imajalmiut. The lordship braces as the War of Fimpe erupts. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Ijiguptuq rally to Imajalmiut's side.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The War of Fimpe ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.
Yovmavzez of Penhashahr takes up the cause of the safety of the lordship.

Labbay of Miprof takes up the cause of the safety of the lordship.

Weloh of Lohyihtohwa takes up the cause of wealth.

Khudresa of Hasluylal takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
A perilous interregnum grips Hasluylal following the heirless death of Khurzagbaa (a hunting accident). Retainers of House Vokhmet storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Rea II of Kuojing takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.

Ecstatic revelations shake Tedshahr: the prophet Baldug proclaims divine truths, establishing the foundations of the Baldugite Heresy.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Declaring citizen liberty inviolable, the populace of Dushumanagar casts out imperial governors! Renouncing allegiance to Shetodi, Dila proclaims the sovereign Confederation of Dushumanagar.
Dila is acclaimed ruler of Confederation of Dushumanagar.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Military Junta of Shetodi dispatches punitive legions to subdue Confederation of Dushumanagar. The bitter Great Shetodi War is underway.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Pili take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Munsankoku, they hoist republican banners beneath Polomecha to establish the Free Commonwealth of Pili.
Polomecha is acclaimed ruler of Free Commonwealth of Pili.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Grand Marshalate of Munsankoku mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Free Commonwealth of Pili. The Border War of Pili begins in fire and iron.
The civic bell of Wekoche tolls as magistrates and clan heads inaugurate the League of Wekoche, establishing its seat of power.
Memola (Philosopher) founds an academy of logic drawing inquisitive students from distant lands in Shalinabad.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Chihiptlan! Liso seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Kingdom of Chihiptlan!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Spurred by cries for liberty and bread, popular assemblies across Tafeka overthrow the old order! Monarchy is dismantled, and the revolutionary convention inaugurates the Confederation of Tafeka.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Chitlatlan! Yecho seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Protectorate of Chitlatlan!

The Border War of Fozhpih is known as the Unprovoked War in Nimref, and as the Rightful War in Fozhpih.
The sun sets upon Principality of Mutujuaq. Bereft of armies and abandoned by vassals, the lordship collapses into history; Pigali Tupinira escapes into the wilderness.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Conquest of Mutujuaq, Gaqinunaat prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Shetodi overruns the defensive holdfasts of Nashoknagar, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Dushumanagar.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Puluviqa give way! Vanguard forces of Qukigu storm the royal seat of Puluviqa, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
Exhausted by protracted attrition, both sides sign an armistice concluding the War of Chitlatlan (2 years). Scabbards are sheathed and the status quo ante is restored.

The War of Chitlatlan is known as the Great Reckoning among the Tlamo, and as the Plunder among the Yowe.
The Great Tinbin War is known as the Unprovoked War among the Ginbun, and as the Rightful War among the Gohi.
The War of the Koaguo Crown is known as the Unification among the Zizzutbos, and as the Subjugation among the Qea.
The Hundred Days War of Qamusagikuni is known as the Great Reckoning among the Tlamo, and as the Plunder among the Jaqangisaja.
Over the centuries Mebi has worn down on the tongue into Mevi; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Ukatin has worn down on the tongue into Ukachin; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Likitleho has worn down on the tongue into Ligitleho; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Return of the Sun: People of Quvnap wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Viqjis.
Return of the Sun: People of Ivitum wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Ingjuaq.
Return of the Sun: People of Ngaviq wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Ngaviq.
Whale Thanks: Boats of Qukigu are blessed and raced off Lujakigu; sailors are toasted ashore.
Moon Cake Night: Granaries of Khookoe are opened at Fuodu; the whole town eats until dusk.
Denouncing ancient covenants, the heralds of Kingdom of Fozhpih proclaim war upon Trade Federation of Ivitum. Trumpets sound across the frontier as the Great Fozhpih War begins.
Pehnah of Shaqtiy Beyond takes up the cause of the safety of the lordship.
Dynastic extinction strikes Shaqtiy Beyond: Pata dies heirless (a wasting sickness). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Tlahyihnahoh claims the vacant crown.
Muka (Master Artificer) engineers a revolutionary watermill mechanism that doubles grain milling yields in Yeda.
Hontanko (Master Artisan) completes a cathedral ceiling fresco celebrating the history of the lordship in Rinhun.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Lufobe as a mass uprising topples the throne of Grand Duchy of Lufobe! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Fatera proclaims the sovereign Confederation of Lufobe!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Koaguo stir mutiny among garrison troops in Zeazhou!
QUEST COMPLETED: Quest for the Sunken Heirloom in Itiquqar! Genzinko unlocks the sealed adamantine vault, unearthing the sacred relic Ancient Circlet of Mizeqo to global acclaim!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Khookoe pave the Ruoling-Geo Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Ruoling and Geo (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pukkivshahr pave the Pukkivshahr-Hansaka Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Pukkivshahr and Hansaka (+trade, +stability).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Riginunaat, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).
CHAOS WRATH: Tzannik the Architect of Fate unravels the destinies of Koaguo! Magical wild-surges turn treasury vaults to lead and dissolve alliances (-25 gold, -14 stability).
The Children of the Drowned Sovereign marks the doors of Iqajat with a cracked eye; those who see it do not sleep.
The Order of the Cracked Eye gathers in the catacombs beneath Bimpan, whispering of the sight that lies past the veil.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Tlekopesowa.

Yemfamp of Binranzaki fills the treasury, the wealth long sought.

Cherry blossoms fall over Lusuginga; the court of Munsankoku holds poetry contests beneath the trees.
Koaguo dissolves the Wall-Dwellers of Teachings of the Serpent and seizes its houses.
Soldiers scatter a league of the landless in Yeheche; Yeheche keeps serfdom by force.
A creed of one station for all spreads through the towns of Tinbin; pamphlets and sermons decry guild castes.
A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of Pisalicho around Pisalicho; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
Delvers of Sanutuq break into a hall of glowing crystals beyond Sanutuq; the deep realm grows.
After 29 years of vassalage, Empire of Hasluylal is formally annexed by Madqilia.
Zhodhin squeezes the shaft-tolls of Usajurav; the miners of Amat mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Apinaltuq bars the shaft to Shusnuz, and the tithe-collectors of Kishahr are turned back at the lamps of Bufumbe.
Kishahr squeezes the shaft-tolls of Pili; the miners of Munsankoku mutter beneath the stone.
Munsankoku squeezes the shaft-tolls of Kusituq; the miners of Tujujama mutter beneath the stone.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Papnap close the air-lanes above Refkand, starving Munsankoku of the high trade.
The walls of Ingjuaq crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Fozhpih breach the defenses of Ivitum's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.

monsters.name: Ziz the Storm-Sovereign

monsters.name: The Great Sun Lion

monsters.name: The Red-Fearing Nian

monsters.name: Timingila the Whale-Swallower
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

monsters.name: Smokeless-Fire Ifrit
monsters.lore: A spirit of smokeless fire, proud and cunning, bound by old seals and older bargains.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

Tsohchud of Hunmunzaki comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
House Lichpah of HihTawantin and House Tikwuwrahpat of Tutqar were joined in royal marriage.
House Jaszadzijkuq of Yamnijia and House Torrahov of Zamiga were joined in royal marriage.
Yagngula conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using assault (score 16 vs DC 8). Defeated Gorath. Promoted to F-Rank!

Tsigzata survived descent to Layer 2 (Forest of Whispers), enduring 21 strain damage: Nausea, severe headaches, and limb numbness upon ascent. Whistle tier: blue. Salvaged ancient relic: Inverted Bell of Whispers!
Monks of Dordom carve a church straight down into the rock near Sothe.
Caravans of a thousand camels reach Dosugo; Shaqtiy prospers on the incense road.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Paftal; the deep wardens double their watch.
A royal wedding joins Qatrinpak of HihTawantin and Qukwira of Tutqar; the two realms are united under one crown.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Chupchar bars the shaft to Dosynygø, and the tithe-collectors of Dosynygø are turned back at the lamps of Shaqtiy.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Nasnegara close the air-lanes above Dentenbonren, starving Hunmunzaki of the high trade.
First contact: the people of Nukrun (Catacombs III) and of BypRus (Catacombs I) find one another along an old shaft and learn that their worlds are not alone.
The Conquest of Dordom is known as the Reclamation in Gogchasum, and as the Usurpation in Dordom.
Gogchasum's invasion through the Starlit Door into Tlotri was repulsed at Merenu.
Flames engulf the towers of Qashsiy! Soldiers of Nabmez force the inner courtyards of Qashsiy's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
A catastrophic blow to BypRus: legions of Hunmunzaki overrun the citadel of Tabhubice, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Feast of Lights: The longest night in Sosgondar is spent by firelight in Sosgondar, with stories and gifts.
The walls of Dosynygø crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Bub breach the defenses of Dosynygø's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
A catastrophic blow to Dar Yashruj: legions of Shaqtiy overrun the citadel of Dar Yashruj, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.

The final citadels fall, and the crown of Democratic Union of Qashsiy is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Surshud Danqissus flees into bitter exile as the lordship fades into legend.
The Hundred Days War of Qashsiy reaches its conclusion after 2 years of bloodshed: Nabmez triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Winter Nights: Families in Gøgepøny set out lamps and food for their dead at Gøgepøny.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Dosynygø Campaign after 2 years. With frontiers redrawn, Bub dictate terms to the vanquished.
Humbled, High Realm of Dosynygø bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Bub, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Bub mandate total political reorganization in Dosynygø! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Free Trading Cities of Dosynygø.
Vapara of Mushude takes up the cause of glory.
In the royal halls of Mushude, Feteta the Exile Kumubaporo breathes their last, succumbing to a wasting sickness. Vapara ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
Gan (Master Artificer) constructs a magnificent clockwork astrolabe atop the harbor watchtower in Finring.
Yisa (Grand Champion) sweeps all contenders in the Grand Tourney to ecstatic cheers from thousands in Lezhabad.

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Zatticha strike at midnight in Vethrike! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Marshalate of Vethrike!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Mushude strike in the dead of night, slaying Zahtop in the court of Chaftsur!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Gihamark are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Dosynygø!
QUEST COMPLETED: Raising the Sunken Ship of Durn! Tedd brings up the ship and its sword-hoard, winning the sacred relic Iron-bound Amulet of Fungring!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Surshud embarks upon the Quest for the Sunken Heirloom in Hizkand! Surshud deciphers faded parchment maps and astrological charts pointing toward the vaults of Hizkand.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Zazorizamin pave the Zhekand-Timorefe Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Zhekand and Timorefe (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Beta Heq pave the Luhzel-Nebsum Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Luhzel and Nebsum (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Shaqtiy! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Luxuria the Gilded Prince intoxicates the high courts of Nasnegara with exquisite hedonism! Opulence surges alongside reckless decadence (+40 gold, -10 stability).
The Covenant of the Pale Vigil gathers in the catacombs beneath Hikhikha, whispering of the sight that lies past the veil.
A bone-masked seer, Tømi, descends into Fuvågø and speaks the names of those who will die before spring.
A bone-masked seer, Shakdektem, descends into Sosgondar and speaks the names of those who will die before spring.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Bunmensaka (Hunmunzaki); tax riots in Hurzel (Beta Yemrosh).

The Invasion of Lasboch is known as the Great Reckoning among the Kinhunwin, and as the Plunder among the Lihbap.
The Dosynygø–Dosynygø War is known as the Vindication in Dosynygø, and as the Aggression in Dosynygø.
The Great Hunmunzaki War is known as the Reclamation among the Kinhunwin, and as the Usurpation among the Lihbap.
The Invasion of Qashsiy is known as the Rightful War among the Qan, and as the Unprovoked War among the Duyqis.
Over the centuries Teyngotnagara has worn down on the tongue into Cheyngotnagara; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Sorohadu has worn down on the tongue into Soroadu; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Kenkawa has worn down on the tongue into Kenkaw; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Water Festival: People of Gegdid wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Gegdid.
Day of Drawn Swords: Warriors of Suntunkawa parade and wrestle in the squares of Letabad to honour the old victories.
Day of the Mummies: Families in Hilnihqal set out lamps and food for their dead at Winquw.
Kaprita of Chalsuyu takes up the cause of glory.
The bells of Chalsuyu toll for the passing of Parrurhata the Bold Kuktal (poison). The youth Kaprita ascends the throne under a regency council.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Tivøfjord divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Dosynygø!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Tivøfjord are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Dosynygø!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Bub sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Winsuyu.
QUEST COMPLETED: Liberation of the Captive Sage in Shabad! Wowbaqdeka successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Dordom pave the Sothe-Sebdar Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Sothe and Sebdar (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Hakratcocha pave the Hakratcocha-Mangyang Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Hakratcocha and Mangyang (+trade, +stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Khorvath the Blood Lord floods the warriors of Zamiga with bloodthirsty slaughter! Mortal legions butcher foes with demonic savagery (+25% army power, -8 stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign hurls deafening thunderbolts across the frontiers of Dosynygø, scattering hostile vanguards with righteous gales (+15% army power).
Gezheva, eyes sewn shut, preaches in Mushude that the fallen sovereign will return to those who gaze inward.
Wandering knight Bosa breaks a demigod’s siege of Mulesedake; the bells ring for a week.
The Hunters of the Last Lantern gathers in the catacombs beneath Hefustan, whispering of the sight that lies past the veil.
Wandering knight Yotha breaks a demigod’s siege of Rønustad; the bells ring for a week.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Titstysk (Lasboch).

Rinyum conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using assault (score 23 vs DC 8). Defeated Gorath. Promoted to F-Rank!
Rathva survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 10 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Bonfires blaze for midwinter in Fusu; the hall of Ligømaby rings with sagas and mead.
The Verdant Circle of Pytshoshtits finds patrons in Bincofnum.
Delvers of Chodsk break into an underground lake beyond Pudsk; the deep realm grows.
A warm current sweeps past Davkhigird; shoals of silver fish and drifting pearls enrich Davkhigird.
A royal wedding joins Denganga of Cinkhing and Canggang of Finkhing; the two realms are united under one crown.
Zamiga squeezes the shaft-tolls of Oyo-rese; the miners of Gøgepøny mutter beneath the stone.
Hunmunzaki squeezes the shaft-tolls of Titstysk; the miners of Lasboch mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Lasboch bars the shaft to Mansun, and the tithe-collectors of Hunmunzaki are turned back at the lamps of Lasboch.
Hunmunzaki squeezes the shaft-tolls of Chitbamba; the miners of Bub mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Chupchar bars the shaft to Dosynygø, and the tithe-collectors of Dosynygø are turned back at the lamps of Qalhup.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Vazhimapeba close the air-lanes above Sunyash, starving Shaqtiy of the high trade.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Tewati close the air-lanes above Dentenbonren, starving Hunmunzaki of the high trade.
SEA EMBARGO: Davkhigird seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Badusy for Ligømaby.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Eclipse Wolf
monsters.lore: A terrifying dread wolf of midnight taigas, capable of swallowing whole warbands beneath the winter moon.

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: White Tiger of the Ridge
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: Roc the Sky-Render
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: Glacies the Glacial Drake
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: Kraken the Fleet-Devourer
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: The River Kappa
monsters.lore: A water imp with a dish of water on its head; bow to it, and courtesy forces it to bow back and spill its strength.

monsters.name: The Basilisk of the Ruins
monsters.lore: A crowned serpent whose gaze turns the living to stone; only a mirror or a weasel defeats it.

monsters.name: Nian the New-Year Beast
monsters.lore: A horned beast that comes down from the mountains each new year, driven off only by red banners and firecrackers.

monsters.name: Smokeless-Fire Ifrit
monsters.lore: A spirit of smokeless fire, proud and cunning, bound by old seals and older bargains.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

The Hundred Days War of Hawifa is known as the War of Deliverance among the Qigugisuqi, and as the Years of Ash among the Matu.
The War of Ziuling is known as the Liberation among the See, and as the Betrayal among the Mazwuhnizmay.
Over the centuries Tu'pupejosu has worn down on the tongue into Tu'pupejos; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Rerowetevifi has worn down on the tongue into Rerowetevivi; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Kuzhofahe has worn down on the tongue into Kuzhofah; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Ngiwahu give way! Vanguard forces of Wo'jinajaw storm the royal seat of Pupimawo, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
Griots’ Epic Nights: Scholars and singers of Befuluba compete in Fane; the best verse is carried through the streets.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: Free Trading Cities of Pupimawo is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Hoturoka Rafo flees into obscurity.
Feast of the Return Voyage: Boats of Munukelu are blessed and raced off Vewirito; sailors are toasted ashore.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Pupimawo Succession War after less than a year. With frontiers redrawn, Wo'jinajaw dictate terms to the vanquished.
Drowned Hour Feast: Boats of Relugg are blessed and raced off Relugg; sailors are toasted ashore.
First Fruit Offerings: Granaries of Naketika are opened at Naketika; the whole town eats until dusk.
Envoys from Wo'jinajaw and Tuhukete exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Envoys from Cimhabsim and Fafsush exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Rift-Dominion of Nantun launches a determined invasion into Grand Duchy of Morihinui, igniting the Hundred Days War of Morihinui.
Exhausted by protracted attrition, both sides sign an armistice concluding the Hundred Days War of Morihinui (less than a year). Scabbards are sheathed and the status quo ante is restored.
Li'yo (Master Artificer) engineers a revolutionary watermill mechanism that doubles grain milling yields in E'pijo.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Pihnokeh strike at midnight in Pehnihtlan! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Kingdom of Pehnihtlan!

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Ly'leraxa strike at midnight in Taxyukkuqxeq! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Theocracy of Taxyukkuqxeq!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Fuva strike at midnight in Khonose! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Kingdom of Khonose!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Munukelu divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Bludlu!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Ki-yowoba stir mutiny among garrison troops in Wilaruroa!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Heno embarks upon the Search for the Lost Poet Cycle of Tanafu! Heno follows a rumor that a famous cycle of poems was hidden in a tower library at Tanafu.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Ziuling pave the Ziuling-Togeka Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Ziuling and Togeka (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Zhapebo pave the Tikyeh-Puwe Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Tikyeh and Puwe (+trade, +stability).
CHAOS WRATH: Luxuria the Gilded Prince plunges the lords of Wuno into ruinous hedonism! Nobles squander municipal reserves on grotesque bacchanals (-35 gold, -12 stability).
A bone-masked seer, Yoklut'aqa, descends into Tikyeh and speaks the names of those who will die before spring.
Wandering knight Shepa breaks a demigod’s siege of Vanose; the bells ring for a week.
The Choir of the Hollow Crown marks the doors of Yyl'ukloth with a cracked eye; those who see it do not sleep.

Kishaga conquered Floor 2 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using tactic (score 11 vs DC 8). Defeated Vorgar. Promoted to F-Rank!
Sesdon survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 10 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red.
Rodelowedara completes a coral-stone harbour mosque at Bu-waralo, a marvel of the Yedopogadanu people.
The Verdant Circle of Te Voriwe takes shape in Nantun Beyond: poets who prize a new, plainer verse.
The Wall-Dwellers of Ilkaxket Pantheon is founded in U'xitqyth; it withdraws to bare cells to live by silence and fasting.

Dadladshia Shuvnash founds the Voice of the Guilds in Hedcob; its pamphlets call for enfranchisement across Cimhabsim.
Susa bint Nasa al-Kuri founds the League of the Clear Cup in Jatabar; its pamphlets call for temperance across Jatabar.
The new rulers of Taxyukkuqxeq sweep away free guilds and decree caste order.
A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of U'xitqyth around Yyl'ukloth; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
The tiny Free Trading Cities of Hawifa seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Wuji.
Ziuling squeezes the shaft-tolls of Xyyghquak; the miners of Fefi mutter beneath the stone.

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: Ziz the Storm-Sovereign
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Storm Roc of the Badlands
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Tusk-Lord of the Briars
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: Shadow of the Loch
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: The Forest Sasabonsam
monsters.lore: A long-legged forest being that dangles from the canopy to snatch the careless traveller.

monsters.name: The Bakunawa of the Lake
monsters.lore: A great sea serpent that rises to swallow the moon; villagers drive it back by banging pots and pans until it spits the moon out.

monsters.name: Draugr of the Howe
monsters.lore: An undead warrior who guards the treasure of its burial mound, growing heavier than an ox.

monsters.name: The Red-Fearing Nian
monsters.lore: A horned beast that comes down from the mountains each new year, driven off only by red banners and firecrackers.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
